title: Advertising wagons and the old market
summary: He played drums on advertising wagons; description of the open market.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you ever play in any markets or stores or anything?

Not, no, no. I heard of that. Reggie they used to tell me. No, I never did. You used to play advertisement for them? Oh, yeah. You see, I played, I have time, way back, a few days, using wagons and horse to go around. That's the time I was playing drums, though. But that was a weird, you know, beginning. I never played no trumpet on, no, no, half a time. Not as I can remember.
Well, what was the market like in those days? I mean, I think.
Well, it was, it was, the market we had here was like, I'll say a building with four posts and a roof.
No oil. No oil, that's right. And what did they sell then?

Well, they had these stands built up, but all that was open. They stayed open day and night. See, and I didn't have trouble nobody didn't steal them. That's the only way they did it. They still wanted to start it closing or later, start it closing, you know, you see.
